about: Wick's lantern: every shot, trail, impact and effect. Generated by cast/light.py.
palette: core.PAL (20 colours), every pixel exact and opaque or transparent
units: pixels at 320x180; origin = the pixel of the frame that sits on the anchor point

flare.note: Frames 0-1 play before the volley (lead 110 ms), the shots leave on frame 2. At fire_interval < 0.22 s use flare_quick instead.

flare_quick.note: Lead 30 ms; shots leave on frame 1.

smear.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)
smear.note: Played once per volley in the aim direction, starting with the volley.

needle_star.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)

needle_rose.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)

needle_lime.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)

needle_sky.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)

needle_coral.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)

needle_blue.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)

impact.note: Frame 0 is the impact; its 50 ms include the target's hit-stop.

toll_1.note: Frame 0 is the impact; its 60 ms include the target's hit-stop.

toll_2.note: Frame 0 is the impact; its 70 ms include the target's hit-stop.

toll_3.note: Frame 0 is the impact; its 90 ms include the target's hit-stop.

chime.note: The bell toll's splash: played on each enemy the toll ring reaches (see splash).

dart.rows: 16 directions: row d faces angle d*22.5 deg (0 = +x right, clockwise, +y down)
dart.note: A firefly away from its orbit, stinging (see sting); while away it draws above Wick and the enemies.

fly_trail.note: Behind a darting fly (dart): one every 3 px travelled, out and back, like trail_t0 behind shots. Plays once and is removed. PARTICLES sold: skip these.

sting.note: Frame 0 is the contact; its 50 ms include the enemy's hit-stop.

death_small.note: Body box about 12 px. Play with the body dissolve rule (deaths.dissolve).

death_medium.note: Body box about 18 px. Play with the body dissolve rule (deaths.dissolve).

death_large.note: Body box about 26 px. Play with the body dissolve rule (deaths.dissolve).

directions.rule: d = posmod(round(atan2(vel.y, vel.x) / (TAU / 16)), 16); row d of a directional sheet. Never rotate or scale a sprite at runtime; snap every draw position to whole pixels.

launch.from: hero.json emit point of Wick's current frame (relative to the feet anchor, +x right, +y down). Every shot of a volley spawns at emit.
sequence: anticipation + wind-up: when _fire_cd <= lead_ms and a target exists, play `flare` (frames 0-1) at emit
smear: the volley fires on flare frame 2; on that frame also play `smear` (row = aim direction) at emit
prism split: if the volley has 2+ shots, also play `prism_glint` at emit
follow-through + recover: flare frames 3-4 finish while the shots fly
launch.quick_when: fire_interval < 0.22 s (fire_mult > 1.55): use `flare_quick` (shots leave on its frame 1)
launch.lantern_behind: when hero.json says lantern_behind for the frame, draw flare/smear/glint before Wick
launch.hero_cast: start HERO's `cast` lantern overlay 30 ms before the volley, so its frame 1 (the raised, flaring lantern) is the volley frame; emit then follows the cast frame's emit (+ its hand offset). LIGHT's flare is anchored to emit, so it rides the lantern up.
launch.glow_tier_suggestion: HERO's lantern_t0/t1/t2: t0 with no LIGHT power on, t1 with 1-3 of shots, pierce, range tier, damage tier, fireflies, wake on, t2 with 4+ (used by the showcases)

shot.compose: shot = core x colour x trail. One sprite per bullet, chosen when it spawns.

slot_colours.about: colour per bullet index i (the i of low_settings.gd _update_fire, angle = aim + (i - (n-1)/2) * 0.25 rad), by volley size n = 1 + shots. 'core' = the centre shot.
slot_colours.6+: extend outward with blue, then repeat rose, lime, sky, coral

core.pierce == 0: slot 'core' -> `ember` (no direction); glass slots -> `shard` row <glass>, start frame = i % 4
core.pierce >= 1: every slot -> `needle_<key>` row d (key = 'star' for the core slot, else the glass); start frame = i % 4

trail.colour_motes: always (tier 0+): from 6 px past emit, every 3 px travelled drop one `trail_t0` (embers, shards) or `trail_needle` (needles), row = the shot's colour key ('gold' for the ember, 'star' for the core needle, else the glass), at the exact path point; it plays once and is removed. PARTICLES sold: skip these.
trail.tier: range_mult < 1.10 -> 0 (colour motes only); 1.10..1.40 -> 1 (`moon_t1`); >= 1.40 -> 2 (`moon_t2`). Range sales: PARTICLES OFF (+15%) turns tier 1 on, RESOLUTION HALF (+25%) tier 2.
trail.moon_drop: from 12 px past emit (keeps Wick readable inside his own volleys), every 2 px travelled, drop number k (0, 1, 2...): tier 1 uses row 'ripple' when k % 12 == 6, else 'glint' offset sideways (perpendicular to the velocity, + = to the right of travel) by round(1.5 * sin(dist / 6)); tier 2 uses 'crescent' when k % 24 == 12, 'ripple' when k % 12 == 6, else 'glint' offset by round(2 * sin(dist / 7)). Ripples and crescents sit on the path (no offset). Each drop plays once and is removed. In Godot, draw these from each bullet's path history in one _draw() rather than as nodes.
trail.draw_order: moon ripples, then colour motes, then shots (all above enemies' ground shadows, below impacts)

shot.life: unchanged gameplay: the sprite lives as long as the bullet (0.8 s x range_mult) and is removed with it; no fade-out frame (the trail fades on its own).

impact.sheet_by_damage: dmg_mult < 1.25 -> `impact`; 1.25..2.0 -> `toll_1`; 2.0..3.0 -> `toll_2`; >= 3.0 -> `toll_3`. toll_1..3 also splash damage onto nearby enemies, each marked with `chime` (see splash)
impact.where: the bullet position on the hit frame, snapped to pixels
impact.hit_stop: frame 0 ms includes the hit-stop: freeze only the struck enemy (movement and animation) for 50/60/70/90 ms (impact, toll_1, toll_2, toll_3). Never freeze the whole game, never flash the screen.
impact.enemy_flash: the struck enemy draws as a cream silhouette inside its outline for 60 ms (HIT FLASH sold: skip)
impact.pierce: a hit that does not stop the bullet (pierce left) also plays `twinkle` at the hit point

fireflies.rule: Fly k of n uses orbits[n][k][world_tick % 24]: dx, dy from Wick's feet, `frame` of the `firefly` sheet, `behind` = draw before Wick (else after). world_tick advances every 1/12 s, shared with the island's 2 s loop. The flies also sting: a fly sent at an enemy leaves its orbit slot empty, flies out and back drawn with `dart`, and plays `sting` on contact (see sting). orbits holds tables for 1 to 6 flies (17 px wide, 6 px deep, centred 13 px above the feet).

splash.rule: Toll tiers 1-3 splash. On a bullet hit at point P whose impact is toll_t (t >= 1), every OTHER living enemy the ring reaches is splashed once: d = max(0, |enemy centre - P| - its body radius (half its body box, or its collision radius)); if d <= radius[t], then reach_ms[t][round(d)] ms after the hit (when toll_t's ring visibly gets there) apply the splash damage (gameplay's number), its hit flash (60 ms, no hit-stop) and play `chime` row chime_row_by_tier[t] at the enemy's centre (snapped). radius[t] = the outermost pixel of toll_t's rings on their widest frame; reach_ms[t][px] = the start of the first toll_t frame whose ring reaches px; index 0 (the plain impact) has no splash. Both are measured from the sheets by cast/light.py. The struck enemy takes only the bullet's hit. Finale stage 1+ draws `last_hit` (no ring): draw no chime (keep the damage if gameplay keeps it).

sting.rule: When the game sends fly k of n at an enemy (target and cadence are gameplay's), the fly leaves its orbit: skip its `firefly` slot and draw it with `dart` until it is back, above Wick and the enemies (with the shots, under impacts); row = the directions rule on its velocity (this frame's position minus last frame's; on its first frame, the direction to the target). OUT: A = its orbit position when it leaves, T = the target's centre (live; if it dies or vanishes, its last centre), u = elapsed / out_ms, e = 1 - (1 - u)^2 (ease-out), pos = A + (T - A) * e + R(T - A) * arc_px * sin(PI * e), where R(v) = (-v.y, v.x) / |v| (the right of travel). At u = 1 the sting lands: damage (gameplay's number), the enemy's hit flash 60 ms and hit-stop 50 ms, and play `sting` at T. BACK: from H = T at contact to B = the fly's live orbit position (orbits[n][k][world_tick % 24] + Wick's feet), u = elapsed / back_ms, e = u * u * (3 - 2 * u) (ease-in-out), pos = H + (B - H) * e + R(B - H) * arc_px * sin(PI * e), so the way back bows to the other side and the trip draws a loop. At u = 1 it is back in its slot (`firefly`). Snap every draw position to whole pixels. ANIMATIONS sold: `dart` holds frame 0, `sting` shows frame 0 for its whole duration. Finale stage 2+ draws no fireflies (finale.stage_2): no dart and no sting sprite.
sting.trail: While a fly is away (out and back), drop `fly_trail` every 3 px it travels, at the exact path point (like trail_t0 behind shots): each plays once and is removed, layer over (or with the trails under the dart). PARTICLES sold: skip these; finale stage 2+: no flies, no trail.

wake.when: speed_mult > 1.0 (FRAME RATE 20 sells +15% speed): play `wake` at the feet on every hop landing frame (hero.json), at most once per 150 ms; it stays where it was dropped (ground layer).

heal.when: a heart is gained (hp rises): play `heal` at Wick's feet, following him (ground layer, under Wick).

sell_stream.when: a sale lands (the Settings menu closes)
sell_stream.path: mote j (0..17) starts on the screen border at perimeter distance (j + 0.5) / 18 * perimeter, inset 2 px (start at the top-left corner, clockwise); start delay = ((j * 7) % 18) * 30 ms; flight 650 ms; e = u * u with u = elapsed / 650 (it accelerates into the lantern); position = quadratic Bezier (P0 border point, P1 = midpoint + perpendicular * 0.3 * |P2 - P0| * (+1 even j, -1 odd j), P2 = emit now, recomputed each frame). Draw a 1 px tail at the positions 25, 50, 75 and 100 ms earlier in the row's mid colour, mid, core.SHADE[mid], core.SHADE[mid] (row mid colours: gold, rose, sky, lime, ice). Sprite `sell_mote` row = colour key, loop.
sell_stream.arrive: play `sell_absorb` at emit on the first and the last arrival (HERO's lantern flare follows)
sell_stream.layer: above everything but the Settings menu

dissolve.rule: 8 frames x 50 ms. In frame k (0-7) draw the enemy's last frame where core.bayer(world_x, world_y) >= k / 8 (k = 0 draws all), every drawn pixel replaced by colour[k] (keep the sprite's alpha), outline pixels included. Play the `death_<size>` overlay over it at the body centre.

deaths.particles_sold: skip the death_* overlay; the dissolve stays

finale.stage_1: every shot draws `last_shot` row stage1 (colour and core are gone), trails: colour motes with row 'gold' only, no moon; impacts `last_hit` stage1; no smear, prism glint, twinkle or death overlay
finale.stage_2: `last_shot` stage2, no trails, `last_hit` stage2, no fireflies, no wake
finale.stage_3: `last_shot` stage3 (one pixel), `last_hit` stage3, no heal ring; the flare stays (it is the lantern)
finale.display_off: LIGHT draws nothing; HERO's lantern is the last lit thing on screen

degraded.animations_sold: loops hold frame 0 (fireflies hold orbit tick 0); one-shots show frame 0 for their whole duration so hits still read
degraded.hit_flash_sold: skip the cream enemy silhouette only
degraded.other: COLOURS, RESOLUTION, BRIGHTNESS and FOV are the screen shader's job; the sprites were checked in those modes (showcase/readability.png)

layers.ground_fx: on the ground under actors: wake, heal
layers.trails: above ground_fx and actor shadows, below actors
layers.hero_split: fireflies: before or after Wick by `behind`; a `dart` (a fly away stinging) draws above Wick and the enemies, with the shots
layers.over_hero: launch effects at emit, right after Wick (before him when lantern_behind)
layers.over: impacts, twinkles, deaths, fly_trail, sting: above shots
layers.over_all: sell stream: above everything but the menu

powers.base: ember + colour motes + impact spark + flare
powers.shots: prism: glass shards in the fan + prism_glint at launch (LANGUAGE GIBBERISH, VIEW DISTANCE NEAR +1; AIM ASSIST RANDOM +2)
powers.pierce: star needle + twinkle on each pierce (BRIGHTNESS 50%, INPUT DELAY 200 MS)
powers.range: moon trail tier 1 at range_mult >= 1.10, tier 2 at >= 1.40 (PARTICLES OFF, RESOLUTION HALF)
powers.damage: bell toll tier 1 at dmg_mult >= 1.25, tier 2 at >= 2.0, tier 3 at >= 3.0; tiers 1-3 also splash (the ring damages and chimes every enemy it reaches, see splash)
powers.fire: fireflies 1/2/3 at fire_mult >= 1.25/1.6/2.2, and each one stings nearby enemies (`dart` out and back, `sting` on contact, see sting); flare_quick at fire_interval < 0.22 s
powers.hearts: sundial heal ring when a heart is gained (MUSIC OFF, HEARTS HIDDEN)
powers.pixels: last light stages 1-3 as PIXELS are sold
